data.body:
9ca8 unblacked-loveless-toad PASSED plan-review on the FOURTH round -> sign-review -> certified ->
CLAIMED. All 6 children + the epic are now claimed; the gating phase is complete.

Four rounds, and every block was a real defect in MY plan, not gate noise:
 R1 P10  no verification section / no AC naming a proof (DET, structural)
 R2 G6   config_key and feature_flag both counted the same boolean _SECTIONS entry, so one
         definition site produced TWO baseline entries and a per-kind marker could not justify it
         -> made the seven kinds a PARTITION
 R3 E2   the ci_gate row read '29 / 251', ambiguous about which number the baseline locks
    G6   the marker had no defined location for the three kinds detected by filename glob or YAML
         step -> added a per-detection-shape placement table
 R4 E4x2 AC15/AC16 claimed verification by the module-size gate and the complexity ratchet, but
         BOTH scan src/rebar only while every shipped module is under scripts/
    G6   the baseline key was not section-qualified, and allow_insecure is an _as_bool key in BOTH
         reconciler and jira -> two sites would collapse into one entry
Cost: 7 description rewrites, and the 8,000-char admission cap was hit 5 times (peak 9,838). The
gate's own advice — split independent work into child tickets — was probably right; I declined it
because new children would need their own reviews and would hold the parent open, but this ticket
was genuinely larger than its five siblings and the friction was the signal.
